item.title: More than 300 hopefuls sign up for Hong Kong’s Election Committee poll
item.description: More than 300 people signed up for Hong Kong’s Election Committee poll as the nomination period opened on Wednesday, vying for seats on the body that chooses the city’s leader. item.title: Brit adventurer back on UK soil after 28-year round-the-world walk
item.description: British adventurer on a 50,000-kilometre, 28-year trek home from South America without using any transport has set foot on UK soil after swimming the Channel, his publicists said Tuesday.
